verdict.description: clean only when the diff fully implements the plan and you found nothing that must change.

summary.description: Two to four sentences: overall assessment of the change against the plan.

findings.description: Every issue that must be fixed. Empty when verdict is clean.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. F1, F2. Reuse the same id when re-raising a previous finding.

file.description: Repo-relative path, or empty string when not file-specific.

line.description: 1-based line in the new file, or 0 when not applicable.

resolved_previous.description: One entry per finding from the previous round. Empty on the first round.

resolved.description: true when the code now fixes it or the implementer's won't-fix reason is accepted.
